message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Ct.js Nightly
on:
  push:
    branches:
    - develop
jobs:
  Build-and-Deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
    - name: Cache npm dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-node-
    - name: Install intermediate dependencies
      run: npm install
    - name: Initialize the development environment
      run: gulp -f devSetup.gulpfile.js
    - name: Build and publish the app
      run: gulp deploy --nightly --buildNum=$GITHUB_SHA
      env:
        BUTLER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BUTLER_API_KEY }}
",
  "rationale": "Add an npm dependency cache (actions/cache@v4) keyed on the root package-lock.json before npm install. The workflow runs on every push to develop, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable, and a root package-lock.json exists as a stable cache input. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency-download caching pattern. All original steps, the deploy step, and the existing BUTLER_API_KEY secret are preserved unchanged; no permissions are weakened, no new secrets or publishing/deployment operations are added, and no new network access beyond the existing npm install is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
